name: feed-me-demo
description: Runs the container and the three micro frontends together on localhost

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix container install && npm --prefix browse install && npm --prefix restaurant install && npm --prefix profile install
scripts.start: concurrently -n container,browse,restaurant,profile -c yellow,blue,green,magenta "npm --prefix container run dev" "npm --prefix browse run serve" "npm --prefix restaurant run serve" "npm --prefix profile run serve"
